subject: Primemed security intake + certification roadmap
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barnes <alice.barnes@primemed.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:25:00 -0800
Subject: Intro call recap: Primemed security & certification goals

Alice — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Highlights from the call
- Primary ask: vendor security proofing for upcoming enterprise pilot (PII + potential PHI exposure).
- Timeline: procurement would like SOC 2 Type II evidence within ~12 months; Primemed is also exploring ISO 27001 in parallel and wants HIPAA readiness confirmation. FedRAMP is a longer-term consideration for certain customers.
- Scope: initial scope likely limited to Redwood-hosted inference for web app integrations; they’ll confirm if analytics/observability logs are in scope.

Attachments
- I attached the RFP you shared (primemed_RFP_v1.pdf) — thanks.

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) You send the vendor security questionnaire (or permission to upload) — procurement/security team.
2) We will return a completed questionnaire + coverage matrix within 3 business days of receipt.
3) Neha to propose a SOC 2 scoping overlay (what’s in/out) and a high-level timeline for SOC 2 Type II readiness.
4) Jonas to put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and proposed dates for an evidence review call.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire (email + best format)? Also confirm whether PHI is expected to flow to Redwood in the pilot.

Thanks — I’ll loop Neha on the technical/compliance details.

— Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

[Attachment: primemed_RFP_v1.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]

From: Alice Barnes <alice.barnes@primemed.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@primemed.com>, security@primemed.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro call recap: Primemed security & certification goals

Thanks Avery — good summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Questionnaire: procurement will send our standard security questionnaire (Excel) by end of day. For speed, we can accept a completed Excel or a link to a secure folder with your evidence.
- PHI: the pilot will include limited PHI (patient initials + appointment timestamps). Primarily the app will send de-identified assessment responses, but we need HIPAA guardrails documented.
- SOC scope: procurement is asking we prioritize vendors with clear SOC 2 controls for data residency and access controls; Type II preferred, Type I acceptable short-term if Type II is in progress.

I attached the questionnaire we normally use. Please have your compliance team fill columns A–D and provide evidence links where possible.

Alice Barnes
Head of Procurement, PrimeMed
alice.barnes@primemed.com
[Attachment: security-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 250KB)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Barnes <alice.barnes@primemed.com>, security@primemed.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap: Primemed security & certification goals

Thanks Alice — got the questionnaire. Quick internal note and proposed deliverables for the customer: 

(1) Questionnaire approach
- We’ll complete the provided Excel and populate a SOC 2 coverage matrix that maps your controls to our policies and evidence (control owners, artifact links).
- Preferred delivery: secure shared drive (link) + short evidence packet (PDFs) for key controls.

(2) Scope recommendation (initial)
- Include: Redwood hosted inference endpoints used by PrimeMed (prod & staging), access controls, KMS key management for customer secrets, logging/retention for trial data.
- Exclude (initial): internal model training pipelines and candidate research datasets. We can expand scope if customer requires model training audit trail.

(3) Timeline estimate
- Questionnaire completion + coverage matrix: 3 business days after we receive the Excel (by Mon EOD if they sent today).
- Evidence review call: schedule within 5–7 business days after we share completed packet.
- SOC 2 Type II: typical path ~9–12 months for a first Type II after a readiness gap assessment; we can provide short-term mitigations (compensating controls) in the meantime.

(4) HIPAA note
- We support HIPAA-covered workflows; we’ll document our PHI handling and propose a BAA template. Need confirmation on the exact PHI elements and retention windows.

I’ve started filling the high-level coverage matrix; attaching the interim CSV. I’ll produce the completed Excel in the customer format after we map controls.

— Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
[Attachment: soc2-coverage-matrix.csv (csv, 18KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barnes <alice.barnes@primemed.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap: Primemed security & certification goals

Alice, thanks for sending the questionnaire and for the clear priorities. Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

1) Today (Fri): PrimeMed sends final questionnaire and confirms PHI elements + retention requirement.
2) Mon (15 Feb): Redwood returns completed questionnaire + SOC 2 coverage matrix + BAA draft.
3) Tue/Wed (16–17 Feb): Evidence review call (30–45m) — Neha to run through key controls (auth, KMS, logging, incident response).
4) Week of 22 Feb: Procurement/Legal follow-up on BAA and standard T&Cs.
5) March: If the MAP is accepted, we’ll run a readiness assessment and produce a gap plan for SOC 2 Type II (9–12 months target).

Action items for PrimeMed: confirm questionnaire owner and share any vendor risk thresholds you use (e.g., encryption at rest required for all third-party data).

If that timeline looks good, I’ll propose calendar invites for the evidence review and our MAP tracker (simple shared doc).

Thanks — Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (617) 555-0124
